concept: Indian Railways sleeper compartment: the necklace hangs where the emergency chain would be, the toggle as the pull handle.
headline: Pull for compliments.

No passengers, no signs, no lettering anywhere. Fix from the previous attempt: the chain was looped over the rod twice, making four strands with loose free ends; this time it is one single continuous closed necklace over the rod at one point, exactly two hanging lengths joined at the bottom by the clasp, no loose ends, no extra strands. The links must stay open elongated paperclip links, never cable, curb, rope or rolo links; the ring must stay a spring-gate sailor ring with its slimmer gate and push-pin nub, never a plain closed donut; the bar must stay short and straight, about 0.6 times the ring's width, never with ball ends, a hook or a shackle, never a lobster clasp; nothing hangs from the ring, no pendant, no charm.
